description: Change one of the signed-in user's saved stacks or audits: its name, how many users it has now (mau_now) or expects (mau_forecast), whether to email them when it changes (alerts), which build-pack steps are done (build_progress, for plans) and which steps of a host move are done (migration_progress, for audits). With alerts on, Kong Reviews checks it every day and emails when a vendor's price change moves its monthly cost, when a cost jump or a startup credit running out is about 45 days away, and once a month to ask for the current user count. Alerts need a confirmed email: pass email to send the confirmation link (GitHub sign-in shares no email). Updating users re-prices it and makes today the start of its projection. Needs sign-in.

alerts.description: Email the user when prices, cost jumps or credits change this stack.

answers.description: Answers to the plan's questions (from get_saved_stack), kept with the stack so a re-plan doesn't ask again. Plans only. Re-prices the stack.

confirmed.description: Question ids whose assumption is right, e.g. ["region", "builder"].

data_in_eu.description: true: user data has to stay in the EU. false: no region requirement.

per_user.description: Usage per active user a month, e.g. {"sms": 2, "file_storage_gb": 0.2, "ai_input_ktok": 30}. Replaces the profile and the filled-in defaults for those units; a plan's questions say which unit each answer sets. Units: mau, seat, request_million, bandwidth_gb, db_storage_gb, egress_gb, email, event, error_event, compute_hour, revenue_usd, transaction, ai_input_ktok, ai_output_ktok, kv_read, kv_write, ci_hour, file_storage_gb, file_egress_gb, file_write, file_read, video_min_stored, video_min_delivered, sms, job_run, search_request, search_record.

users_per_account.description: People who use it at each business customer.

build_progress.description: Tick build-pack steps done (true) or not done (false), by step id from get_build_pack: domain or the step's category (hosting, database, auth…). Plans only.

email.description: Where alerts go. A confirmation link is sent first; only ask for it when the user wants alerts.

mau_forecast.description: Users expected at the end of the forecast (12 months for audits).

migration_progress.description: Tick a host move's features and cutover steps done (true) or not done (false), by id from plan_migration (e.g. forms, redirects, lower-ttl, switch). Audits only.

unlink_repo.description: Forget the repo linked with check_build, and its last check.

name: update_saved_stack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

title: Update a saved stack: users, name or alerts
